info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Loan Application Submit-spec
info.description: The Loan Application Submission API allows users to submit new loan applications efficiently. This endpoint is designed for lenders and financial institutions to manage the onboarding of applicants seamlessly. Users can provide necessary application details, which are then processed to initiate the loan approval workflow. Typical consumers include banking systems, loan processing software, and financial service applications that require quick and reliable loan application submissions.
